title: CYBRIK org aggregate roll-up request v1 (D-8)
description: A request for a DE-IDENTIFIED subtree roll-up — the concrete INV-1 cross-tier visibility mechanism (ADR-0007 D-8; 02 §2.2). scope_kind is const 'aggregate': this object can only ever ask for counts/metrics over a subtree, NEVER raw records. It carries no objectRef and no raw resource pattern (additionalProperties:false makes a raw-records field structurally impossible), so an ancestor cannot smuggle a raw read through the aggregate path. It names the authorizing scope grant (grant_ref) whose aggregate_scope AND-composes with this request at runtime; the tenant, target subtree, and small-cell floor (const 5, OD-2) MUST match that grant. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

tenant_id.description: The tenant this roll-up is evaluated in. MUST equal requester.tenant_id, target_node.tenant_binding and the authorizing grant's tenant (cross-tenant roll-ups are rejected at runtime; OD-1).

requester.description: The actor asking for the roll-up. Model output can never populate an actor (ADR-0006).

target_node.description: The subtree root to roll up over. An 'external' boundary node is never a valid aggregate target (INV-2).

scope_kind.description: Const 'aggregate': this request is ONLY ever a de-identified roll-up; it can never ask for own-node / descendant / delegated raw reach.

grant_ref.description: The grant_id of the org-scope-grant (aggregate_scope) that authorizes this roll-up. AND-composed with tenant isolation + RBAC + RLS at runtime; a request without a matching, unexpired aggregate grant is denied (FC-1).

small_cell_floor.description: Const 5: the small-cell suppression floor requested must be the OD-2 floor; a smaller floor (weaker suppression) is not expressible.

dimensions.description: The metric dimensions to roll up (e.g. 'severity', 'category'). No raw identifiers; MUST be a subset of the authorizing grant's aggregate_scope.dimensions (runtime).
